app.name: agdash
app.home: agdash, go to the live board

shell.readOnlyDetail: agdash observes your agents and never changes them.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address is not part of agdash.

board.label: Board
board.title: Live board
board.purpose: Every agent session running on this machine, with its state and the evidence behind it.
board.what: Active, waiting and idle sessions grouped by harness and project, with sessions started by other sessions nested under them.

agents.label: Agent graph
agents.title: Live agent graph
agents.purpose: Which live session started which, across harnesses, and how each link is known.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.purpose: Every session agdash has recorded, most recently active first, with its harness, model, folder and size.

search.label: Search
search.title: Search
search.purpose: Find sessions by what was asked, said or run.

board.label: By project
board.title: Sessions by project
board.purpose: Live sessions grouped by the WorkChord project they work under, with their tasks, runs and anything that needs a look.

unmapped.label: Unmapped
unmapped.title: Unmapped sessions
unmapped.purpose: Sessions with no WorkChord project: nothing points at one, or the evidence disagrees.

usage.label: Usage
usage.title: Usage
usage.purpose: Tokens, cost and time as each harness reported them, by harness, model or folder.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Tool use
tools.purpose: Which tools agents call, how often, and how often a call failed.

activity.label: Activity
activity.title: Activity
activity.purpose: When sessions are active: by hour of the week, and how many run at once.

sources.label: Sources
sources.title: Sources
sources.purpose: What agdash can see on this machine.
sources.what: Each harness agdash found, the files it reads, and any records it could not understand.

workchord.label: WorkChord
workchord.title: WorkChord
workchord.purpose: Connect a WorkChord server to map sessions to projects, agents and tasks.

data.label: Data
data.title: Data
data.purpose: How long agdash keeps history, and exporting it.
data.what: Retention settings and exports of sessions to JSONL or Markdown.

empty.noneBody: Sessions appear here once the agdash service has read your harnesses' files.
empty.filteredBody: Clear a filter or widen the dates to see more.

error.unreachableBody: Make sure the service is running on this machine, then try again.
error.refusedBody: The page did not present the service's local token. Open agdash from its app, or restart it.
error.serverBody: Something went wrong while reading the history. Try again.

search.label: Search sessions
search.placeholder: Words from a prompt, reply, thought or command
search.promptBody: Type words from what was asked, said or run. End a word with * to match its beginning.
search.noneBody: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or clear the filters.
search.failed: The search could not be completed.

overview.title: Sessions started per day
overview.caption: Drag, click or shift-click days to pick a range; the list follows.
overview.emptyBody: Once a harness records a session, its day appears here.

usage.caption: Usage by {{group}}
usage.noteDash: A dash means the harness did not report that number; it is not a zero.
usage.noteUnreported_one: {{count}} session reported no usage at all and is left out of the token figures.
usage.noteUnreported_other: {{count}} sessions reported no usage at all and are left out of the token figures.
usage.noteModelTime: Time is per session, and a session can use several models, so time is not split by model.
usage.noteElapsed: Elapsed is the time from a session's start to its last activity, idle time included.

tools.caption: Tool calls by tool
tools.noteErrors: Errors count only results agdash could match to their call; a dash means none could be matched.
tools.noneBody: No session in this selection called a tool, or none has been recorded yet.
tools.noteTruncated: Only the {{count}} most used tools are listed; the totals count every call.
tools.figureCaption: The most used tools first; the hatched end of a bar is the calls that failed. The table below lists the same calls.
tools.errorUnknown: errors not known, no result matched

figure.title: {{measure}} per {{bucket}}, {{group}}
figure.total: {{value}} in all, the same total as the table below.
figure.noneReported: No session in this selection reported this number.
figure.undated_one: {{count}} usage report has no time, so the table counts it and the figure cannot place it.
figure.undated_other: {{count}} usage reports have no time, so the table counts them and the figure cannot place them.
figure.unsplitTitle: Sessions are not split by model
figure.unsplitBody: A session can use several models, so sessions are counted by harness or folder. Choose Tokens or Cost to follow models over time.

activity.weekTitle: Activity by hour of the week
activity.weekCaption: Each cell counts the hours in which a session recorded at least one event, on your clock ({{zone}}). It counts what the harnesses wrote down, not whether anyone was busy.
activity.parallelCaption: How many sessions recorded at least one event in each {{step}}, in all and by harness, on your clock ({{zone}}).
activity.emptyBody: No session in this selection recorded an event with a time.

stream.live: Updates as sessions start, change and end.
stream.retrying: Live updates stopped; reconnecting. The board may be out of date until then.

empty.title: Nothing is running
empty.body: Sessions appear here as soon as a harness starts one. agdash checks the process table every two seconds.

ended.title: Just ended
ended.body: Sessions that ended in the last {{minutes}} minutes.

live.unknownWindow: Sessions in an unknown state show here while they were active in the last {{minutes}} minutes; History has the rest.

error.unreachableBody: Make sure the service is running on this machine. The board loads again by itself once the service answers.
error.refusedBody: The page did not present the service's local token. Open agdash from its app, or restart it.
error.serverBody: Something went wrong while reading the live sessions. The board tries again when the live stream reconnects.

parentBasis.unknown: a link whose basis was not recorded

strips.quiet: No events in the last 30 minutes
strips.key: Each session's lane covers the last 30 minutes, oldest on the left: events per minute above, its state below. Lanes change as sessions write.
strips.eventsKey: Events per minute, darker for more

filter.label: Show sessions by state
filter.noneTitle: No live session is in the states picked
filter.noneBody: Press a state again to show its sessions, or clear them all to see the whole board.

quiet.summary_one: {{count}} session open but quiet for over a day
quiet.summary_other: {{count}} sessions open but quiet for over a day
quiet.about: A session left open with nothing written for {{hours}} hours is folded into one line under the others.

panel.label: Session details
panel.parentNotLive: A session that is not live

agents.none: No session here started another; each stands alone.

reading.starting: Looking for session files. Lists may be incomplete until this finishes.
reading.underway: Still catching up on session files: {{done}} of {{total}} done. Running sessions come first, then the newest; lists may be incomplete until this finishes.
reading.announce: agdash is still catching up on session files. Lists may be incomplete until this finishes.
reading.finished: agdash has caught up on session files. The lists are complete.

credentialDetail.read_only_session: WorkChord refuses any change made with this session.
credentialDetail.full_session: This server has no read-only sessions; agdash still only reads.
credentialDetail.none: This server lets local readers in without signing in.

workchord.objectsLabel: What agdash copies from this server
workchord.noneBody: Connect a server to map sessions to its projects, agents and tasks. agdash only reads from it.

connect.title: Connect a server
connect.addressHint: Such as https://work.example, or http://127.0.0.1:8480 on this computer.
connect.name: Name (optional)
connect.failedUnknown: Not connected. Check the address and try again.
connect.approveBody: Open the approval page, sign in, check that it shows this code, and approve.
connect.approveReadOnly: agdash asks for a read-only session.
connect.approveFull: This server only offers full sessions; agdash still only reads.

rules.title: Rules and pins
rules.purpose: Map sessions that never talk to WorkChord: by folder, repository or launcher, or one at a time.
rules.folderHint: An absolute path. Sessions in this folder or below map to the project.
rules.noProjects: No projects copied from this server yet. Sync it first.

error.unreachableBody: Make sure the service is running on this machine, then try again.
error.refusedBody: The page did not present the service's local token. Open agdash from its app, or restart it.
error.serverBody: Something went wrong while reading the WorkChord settings. Try again.

mapping.noServerBody: Connect a server in Settings to map sessions to its projects.
mapping.emptyBody: Each top-level session has a project, from its own evidence, a rule or a pin.

session.missingBody: There is no session at this address. It may have been removed by retention.
session.emptyBody: This session has no events in agdash's store.

overview.title: Overview
overview.caption: The whole session on one time axis; stretches of over 30 minutes with nothing recorded are squeezed into a marked break. The blue window is the part of the timeline below in view: drag it, click a moment, or use the arrow keys on it to move the timeline there.
overview.partKey: Reasoning not kept, or calls that failed
overview.window: Part of the timeline in view

mapping.title: WorkChord mapping
mapping.caption: How this session is linked on {{server}}: each line says how the link is known, and a dotted one is only a suggestion.
mapping.unmappedBody: Nothing links this session to a WorkChord agent, project, task or run yet. A folder rule or a pin on the Unmapped page can map it.

board.attentionPurpose: Read-only signals from comparing WorkChord's plan with what this machine observes. agdash changes nothing.

run_without_session.long: WorkChord marks run {{run}} on {{task}} by {{actor}} as running, and no live session here is linked to it.

claim_expired.long: The claim on {{task}} expired {{when}}, and this session is still live.

no_task.long: This session works in a mapped project but is linked to no task.
no_task.several: {{count}} sessions work in a mapped project but are linked to no task:

board.unmappedHelp: Live sessions with no project, or with evidence that disagrees.
board.unmappedLink: Map them in the Unmapped queue
board.emptyBody: No session on this machine is active, waiting or idle right now.

activity.label: Activity by project
activity.caption: Each session from its start to its last activity, in the lane of the project it maps to; stretches of over {{hours}} hours with nothing are squeezed into a marked break.
activity.captionLinear: Each session from its start to its last activity, in the lane of the project it maps to, on one time axis with no breaks.
activity.emptyBody_one: No session was active in the last {{count}} day.
activity.emptyBody_other: No session was active in the last {{count}} days.

agents.title: Declared and observed in {{project}}
agents.caption: For each agent, its current assignments against the live sessions mapped to it; the tooltip says how each session was mapped.

charts.keys: Use the arrow keys to move between values; Escape hides the value.

empty.title: Nothing to show
empty.body: No session in this selection reported a value for this figure.

error.title: This figure could not load
error.body: agdash could not get these values from its service. The rest of the page may still be current.

selection.keys: Arrow keys move this edge; with Shift they move the whole range.
